answer.text: Long-term equilibrium allocation based on client's IPS and capital market expectations

explanation.text: The Logic: SAA = long-term 'policy' allocation (e.g., 60/30/10 equity/debt/alt) — durable over market cycles. The Trap: TAA is short-term; SAA is strategic. Cross-Exam Context: Foundational. Manager's Pro-Tip: Review SAA annually; TAA is where month-to-month deviations happen.
